entry.name: AI Governance Professional (AIGP)
entry.note: The vendor-neutral AI governance credential; the governance counterpart to CIPP

covers: Foundational knowledge of AI systems and use cases
Current and emerging laws applying to AI systems
AI risk management context and implementation of responsible AI governance
Unforeseen concerns and debated issues surrounding AI governance
reading.format: Exam-based certification. The page refers to preparing for the exam, an exam format, and testing policies.
reading.summary: The AIGP credential certifies knowledge of responsible AI governance. It shows competency in AI development, ethical AI deployment, and best practices in AI management for safety and trust. It covers foundational AI systems, laws and frameworks, AI life cycle and risk management, and debated governance issues.
reading.audience: Professionals in all industries who need to understand and execute responsible AI governance.
